Synthetic Sage Intacct Web Services recordings for CONNECT-011. These are schema-oriented protocol fixtures, not a recording from a live sandbox. No provider or personal credentials are present.

Envelope, readEntityDetails, getDimensions, lookup, readByQuery/readMore and get_trialbalance requests follow the public XML API documentation at developer.intacct.com (company-console/entities, platform-services/dimensions, general-ledger/general-ledger-detail, general-ledger/trial-balances). The fixture checks requested fields, entity authentication, accrual book, dates, pagination and read-only functions. Trial balances use independent expected account totals, rather than calling product normalization. Company-specific GLDETAIL/UDD lookup fields and trial debit/credit response names still need live sandbox qualification.
